paper_title: Search for QCD coupled axion dark matter with the MICROSCOPE space experiment
notes: Paper constrains the axion-gluon (QCD) coupling 1/f_a via UFF/equivalence-principle violation from MICROSCOPE. Only two anchor points of the exclusion curve are given explicitly in the text: 1/f_a ~ 1.7e-16 GeV^-1 at m_a=1e-20 eV and 1/f_a ~ 1.3e-10 GeV^-1 at m_a~7.7e-14 eV. The full exclusion curve (Fig 2) contains multiple bands and could not be read numerically. Coupling is the QCD axion-gluon coupling (CP-violating, strong-CP related), best matched to AxionCPV among the enum; y-axis is 1/f_a in GeV^-1, NOT the standard dimensionless form, so declared as raw variable. Mass range spans 1e-20 to ~1e-13 eV. Local DM density assumed rho_DM=0.4 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.55, 2))
